summary: MCP list tools without provider paging offer scoped local cursors, reject changed lists, and return oversized items in bounded fragments.
reason: Splitwise groups, friends, categories, comments, and currencies can exceed the MCP output budget. A bounded first page without a cursor silently hides the rest; offsets must not silently skip changed rows or be reused for another expense, and large items must remain retrievable. The output regression test retains significant trailing TSV delimiters.
validated_outcome: Offline tests resume bounded lists, reassemble oversized items, reject cursors for another expense or a changed list, and verify no local cursor reaches the upstream request. The full suite preserves empty trailing TSV cells.
